A1.justification: Both PDFs describe the same LGNSDE research. The main text, equations, figures, tables, and Appendices A–C are readable and match across the changed pagination, supporting a complete comparison.

before.justification: V4 reports original node-classification, OOD-detection, noise-robustness, and active-learning experiments, plus appendix sensitivity, backbone, and runtime comparisons.

after.justification: V5 retains these original empirical results in Section 5 and Appendices B–C.

M1.justification: Section 3 retains the same prior/posterior SDE formulation, GCN drift, shared diffusion, ELBO, numerical solver, and Monte Carlo prediction procedure.

E1.justification: Both versions use Cora, Citeseer, Pubmed, Amazon Computers, and Photo for the same tasks. The appendix label-leave-out and feature-perturbation scenarios are also unchanged.

E2.justification: Comparator membership is unchanged within corresponding experiments, including the main-text comparisons and the broader baseline sets in Tables 13–14. No comparison method is added or removed.

E3.justification: The reported splits, metrics, hyperparameter grids, solver settings, test-noise construction, and active-learning procedures are unchanged in Section 5 and Tables 6–8.

E4.justification: The noise-robustness experiment, prior-drift and diffusion sensitivity results in Tables 9–10, and GCN-versus-GAT analysis in Table 11 and Figure 4 are retained without revision.

E5.justification: Both versions report the same 20 random weight initializations for fixed Planetoid splits, 100 random splits for other datasets, and mean-plus-standard-deviation reporting. No uncertainty-estimation practice changes.

E6.justification: Matched numerical results and plotted findings are unchanged throughout the main text and appendices. For example, Table 5 retains LGNSDE's Cora maximum-entropy active-learning accuracy of 0.8889 ± 0.0067, and Table 12 retains its 1.23-second epoch time.

T1.justification: Section 4 and Appendix A retain the same assumptions, theorem, variance and perturbation bounds, proofs, and discretization argument. Footnote renumbering and equation spacing do not alter the mathematics.

C1.justification: The abstract, introduction, and conclusion retain the same methodological, theoretical, and empirical claims. The added code-availability statement does not change the scientific contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations of entropy separation, robustness, and active learning remain unchanged, as do the Graph GP memory limitation and discussions of computational efficiency and future solvers.

D1.justification: V5 adds an explicit GraphNeuralSDE repository link in the abstract and an introductory footnote; v4 provides neither. This improves code-access documentation, while implementation and experimental details remain unchanged. Repository contents and accessibility are not established by the PDFs.

R1.justification: The cited works, reference list, and Section 6 positioning relative to Bayesian GNNs, graph Gaussian processes, stochastic diffusion, and Graph Posterior Networks are unchanged.

P1.justification: V5 adds a short code-availability sentence and footnote. The scientific prose, terminology, and section sequence otherwise remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figures and table designs remain unchanged, but appendix floats move: Tables 9–10 shift to page 16, Tables 12–13 to page 17, and Table 16 to page 18. Some headings become separated from their tables, and the introductory contribution list also reflows.

improvement.justification: The explicit implementation links added to the abstract and introduction modestly improve code discoverability and reproducibility documentation. Scientific content and evidence remain unchanged. Appendix pagination becomes less tidy, but this limited presentation drawback does not outweigh the practical documentation benefit.
